title: TNBC chromatin-informed regulatory framework transfer pilot

anchor.title: A chromatin-informed transcriptional regulatory framework to stratify patients and guide therapy selection in triple-negative breast cancer

goal.success_definition: A reviewed pilot outcome with traceable direction, data, code, minimal real execution and recorded workflow feedback

constraints.compute: All real data processing and analysis must run on the project cloud server under /media/desk16/iy13202/projects/Paper2Paper; the local checkout is limited to source materials, Git-tracked specifications, code, compact results and reports.

stop_rule: LUAD Figure 1 PASS on 2026-08-14: 97 LUAD-specific TFs replicated in GSE81089; the replicated program passed positive direction, BH FDR<=0.05 and Hedges g>=0.5 in both PDMR PDX and DepMap. Stop after Figure 1 for this task; Figure 2 requires a separately frozen three-system chromatin gate. The prior CRC M-vs-rest FAIL remains preserved in its reports.
